title: Dental PPO Plans Frequency, Interval and Age Limits
content:
Claims Adjudication Manual, Dental PPO Plans — frequency, interval and age limits. The figures for each plan are in the plan's frequency and age limit schedule.

**Frequency limits.** Counted per person, including the line being decided: oral evaluations up to the plan's per-benefit-period count and prophylaxis up to its count; prophylaxis and periodontal maintenance together up to the combined count per benefit period (periodontal maintenance is not covered when that count is 0); topical fluoride up to its count per benefit period.

**Interval limits.** *Former clause, no longer in force as written:* "Interval limits are counted back in calendar months from the date of service to the date of service of the last paid service of the same kind: bitewings once per bitewing interval, a full-mouth series or panoramic film once per full-mouth or panoramic interval, sealants once per tooth per sealant interval, scaling and root planing once per quadrant per its interval, crowns once per tooth per crown replacement interval, bridges and dentures once per tooth span per prosthetic replacement interval, implants once per tooth position per implant interval; the service is payable when its date of service is on or after the last date of service plus the interval." Current wording: for a pre-treatment estimate requested under the estimate-request rule, and only for such a case, implant services of the same kind are those with the same procedure code on the same tooth position, so an implant body, its abutment and its implant-supported crown each run their own implant interval; every other case remains under this wording: interval limits are counted back in calendar months from the date of service to the date of service of the last paid service of the same kind (bitewings once per bitewing interval, a full-mouth series or panoramic film once per full-mouth or panoramic interval, sealants once per tooth per sealant interval, scaling and root planing once per quadrant per its interval, crowns once per tooth per crown replacement interval, bridges and dentures once per tooth span per prosthetic replacement interval, implants once per tooth position per implant interval), and the service is payable when its date of service is on or after the last date of service plus the interval.

**Age limits.** Age is compared on the date of service: fluoride only before the fluoride age limit birthday, and sealants only on permanent molars before the sealant age limit birthday. A line past the age limit is denied for the age limit.

**Over the limit.** A line over a frequency or interval limit is denied for the frequency limit (on an estimate, the estimate carries the frequency-limit remark). Services paid by a prior carrier do not count; services paid under an earlier Cascade dental enrollment of the same person do count.

**Resets.** Benefit-period counts reset on the benefit period start date; interval limits do not reset.

### Boundary case (hypothetical, 12-month bitewing interval)
Last paid bitewings on 10 May: bitewings dated 10 May of the next year are payable; bitewings dated 9 May of the next year are over the interval.

superseded_clauses: Interval limits are counted back in calendar months from the date of service to the date of service of the last paid service of the same kind: bitewings once per frequency_bitewing_interval_months, a full-mouth series or panoramic film once per frequency_fmx_pano_interval_months, sealants once per tooth per sealant_interval_months, scaling and root planing once per quadrant per srp_interval_months, crowns once per tooth per crown_replacement_interval_months, bridges and dentures once per tooth span per prosthetic_replacement_interval_months, implants once per tooth position per implant_interval_months; the service is payable when its date of service is on or after the last date of service plus the interval.
